description: The Mopo project deposits input data for its heat-sector processing workflow as a public 569 MB ZIP with a short README. The README identifies ArchetypeBuildingModel outputs, Danish Energy Agency technology catalogues, Eurostat degree days, JRC-IDEES, Hotmaps building-demand scenarios and when2heat series. These sources can be reused to prepare heat-pump performance and heating or cooling demand inputs for European energy-system simulations. Zenodo labels the combined deposit CC BY 4.0, but the README says the rights for an included European Commission heating-and-cooling study are unclear. The package is a bundled input collection, not the processing code or its published output time series. Component dates, formats and transformations are partly documented by their original providers and were not reconciled here. A related catalogue record covers the processed Mopo heat-sector time series, not this raw input package. The ZIP was not downloaded, so its internal files, checksums and compliance with each upstream licence remain unverified.
